order.cumulative: Successive adoption remains on; simultaneous reference q=2/3 each in [0,60), then all q=1. Total dose 210 matches, individual-tool doses do not match each ordering.
order.equal: One tool at a time for 20 rounds, then all on for 30; simultaneous reference q=1/3 in [0,60), then all on. Each tool dose is 50 in every scenario.
order.ongoing_projects: Provision windows govern new offers; do not terminate adopted project processes when a window changes.

pilot_precision.target: Seven endpoint-minus-000 paired mean normalized-burden differences
pilot_precision.not_guaranteed: Four pilot seeds only; static endpoint variance does not establish precision for strength, interactions or order contrasts.

inference.model_sampling: Independent model draws, no claim of provider seed reproducibility
inference.missing: Complete paired contrasts plus worst-case normalized-burden bounds over all planned blocks
inference.multiplicity: Holm within prespecified contrast families; confidence intervals remain pointwise
inference.rq1_primary: Seven non000-versus-000 endpoint contrasts plus six pairwise tool interactions conditional on the third tool being 0 or 1 (13 primary contrasts).
inference.rq1_exploratory: Seven marginal factorial contrasts are separate exploratory hypotheses, not substitutes for the six conditional interactions.
inference.order_windows: Report both the complete 90 rounds and the final 30-round common all-on window; adjust both windows within each order family's prespecified tests.
inference.reporting_scale: Report original U differences and CIs in unresolved-Issue-rounds alongside normalized differences; scaling denominator is 12H for each outcome window.
inference.zero_variance: Report zero sample MCSE and degenerate t interval descriptively; t p-value undefined
inference.sensitivity: Pairs reuse first six static seeds and baseline endpoint results; sensitivity is not independent confirmation of the main study.
inference.valid_data: Only complete verified real-model records enter formal inference. Offline/scripted records are test-only.

authorization: Design generation and sample-size planning never execute runs or change API controls. Formal stages remain awaiting_pilot_freeze until an explicit separate freeze/authorization step.
counts_formula: 6+32+33*N+14*N+4*N+8*4*6 = 51*N+230; plus eight technical reruns, maximum 850 at N=12
